name: hypertask_search
does: Search tickets by text and filters, retrieve semantic document chunks, find related tickets, or search product help.
use_when: Use tasks for keyword discovery, semantic for relevant evidence passages, related for neighbors of a ticket, and help for product instructions.
do_not_use_when: Do not use when you already know a ticket number and need its current fields; use hypertask_tasks get instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. query is plain text; tasks supports the existing search operators and structured filter, semantic supports metadata_filters, related accepts a ticket identifier or text. Returned semantic evidence keeps passage text and source references.
